contextReview.basis: Direct review: clear, sunny daytime East Asian urban running routes: a tree-lined riverside promenade with a city skyline, a sloping residential lane with a stone step, a shaded pavement past hedges and low apartment blocks, a street-side drinking fountain, and a riverside railing with apartment blocks and a bridge; hard direct sun with sharp shadows, blue sky and a visible sheen of sweat on skin. No rain is depicted; the wet paving at the fountain is fountain water. The East Asian urban region and the humid setting are the producer's reviewed mapping; humid is a styling setting, not a measurement. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: The handoff and READY.json record that the user explicitly approved these five female running editorials and full automation of this batch (userApprovedEditorials true, currentBatchExplicitAuthorization true; 2026-11-07). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The riverside promenade, its railing, trees, hedges, the river and the skyline are the setting, not products. Her arms are raised to the headband, so the singlet's back and the sports bra's hidden front and band are conservatively reconstructed; the singlet is restored alone, without the bra. The watch dial and the small hoops are small in frame and their details are inferred. Both runners and both socks are visible and listed as pairs. Brand, fibre composition, metal, performance and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual worn silhouettes, colors and accessories matched. Hidden fronts restored conservatively.
First singlet source alpha flecks evaluated at final 500px: no visible floating debris on any background.
Independent garments only; no stray shoes or scene props.
Producer reviewed the editorials and all twenty-nine products. Humid is a styling setting. Hidden fronts reconstructed conservatively. Exclude scene props. No brand, price or verified fiber claims.

deck.ko: 화이트 메시와 코발트가 만드는 선명한 러닝 조합.
deck.en: White mesh and cobalt create a crisp running combination.
deck.de: Weißes Mesh und Kobaltblau bilden eine klare Laufkombination.

intro.ko: 강변 그늘을 나서기 전 헤드밴드를 고쳐 씁니다.
intro.en: A pause at the edge of the riverside shade becomes a moment to adjust a headband.
intro.de: Am Rand des Schattens am Fluss wird das Stirnband kurz gerichtet.

body.ko: 흰 메시 싱글릿 아래 검정 브라가 드러나며 가벼운 레이어의 구조를 보여줍니다. 코발트 쇼츠의 흰 곡선 테두리는 흰 양말과 신발로 이어집니다. 검정 헤드밴드와 시계 스트랩이 밝은 조합을 정돈하고 작은 은색 후프가 마무리합니다.
body.en: The black bra remains visible beneath the white mesh singlet, making the light layering easy to read. White curved piping on cobalt shorts connects to white socks and runners. A black headband and watch strap balance the bright palette, finished with small silver hoops.
body.de: Der schwarze Sport-BH bleibt unter dem weißen Mesh-Singlet sichtbar. Weiße Bogenpaspeln an den kobaltblauen Shorts führen zu weißen Socken und Laufschuhen. Schwarzes Stirnband und Uhrenband ordnen die helle Palette, kleine silberne Creolen ergänzen sie.

pull.en: One strong color sets the rhythm.
pull.de: Eine kräftige Farbe gibt den Takt.

copy.pullQuoteEn: One strong color sets the rhythm.

tip.ko: 헤드밴드는 머리선에 평평하게, 싱글릿은 허리 위에 느슨하게 두세요.
tip.en: Keep the headband flat at the hairline and the singlet loose over the waist.
tip.de: Das Stirnband flach am Haaransatz und das Singlet locker über dem Bund tragen.
